notes: I personally viewed the PNG produced by Inkscape. The top band says to freeze the training, validation and final-check data families first. Four colored boxes and arrows show pretraining saves A, SFT reads A and saves B plus its parent fingerprint, joint reads B and saves C, and the dashed preference branch reads C and saves D. The joint box explicitly identifies C as the recommended version. The bottom band says to repeat the same capability check at each stop and send tool results back to the same core. Chinese labels, numerals and arrows are legible; I saw no clipped labels or overlapping text. PPO, distillation and quantization are named in the bottom annotation, but their details are not needed to understand section 19.5’s demonstrations.
